invariants: Profitability calculations must use evidence-backed revenue and cost inputs
Unknown or materially stale cost inputs must not produce a HEALTHY decision
Internal AI/build failures, regressions and implementation mistakes must be tracked as internal rework cost
Customer-approved Change Requests may alter revenue/cost baseline only after approval evidence
Profitability status must not automatically change a customer price or reject a customer
Capacity HOLD must prevent new scheduling promises but must not cancel existing customer commitments automatically
P0 incidents and critical support load reserve capacity before new discretionary work
Estimated contribution margin is an internal planning metric and not a customer invoice amount
Human commercial approval is required for repricing, rescoping or declining work
